defects: The solid matte material restores continuous brown faces, but the profile still shows several closely spaced contour bands at the bottom and crown edge.
The surface has no visible grain variation, while the approved target retains subtle broad wood grain.
hard_fail_reasons: Close craftsmanship remains below target because the profile transition lines still compete with the broad faces.
Surface variation remains below target because the solid finish removes all of the target's restrained wood grain.
incumbent_comparison: In matched production captures, v002 replaces v001's repeated orange material bands with broad continuous dark-brown faces. The resulting material is calmer, but it is uniformly smooth and the profile still carries extra contour lines.
likely_causes: The initial profile contour contains more transitions than the approved shallow cove/reveal target, and the targeted material correction removed all surface variation.
next_action_hypothesis: For attempt 3, use a materially different trim material recipe with subtle low-frequency grain aligned to the long profile faces, reduce the cross-section to the broad face and a few shallow transitions, and keep the same measured envelopes and room geometry authority.

observations.art_direction_fit: The matte dark-brown faces fit the source wood family better than v001, but the target has restrained grain and fewer profile transitions.
observations.close_up_quality: The v002 baseboard and crown captures show continuous wood-colored faces; several close contour bands remain visible at the baseboard bottom and crown edge.
observations.gameplay_readability: The room view has a darker perimeter band than v001, though the five-inch trim still occupies little screen space in the overhead camera.
observations.geometric_detail: The 5-inch profiles remain dimensionally correct, but the extra transition lines distract from the shallow cove/reveal silhouette.
observations.material_realism: The matte stained color approaches the source, while the completely uniform finish lacks the target's subdued natural wood variation.
observations.proportion: The sample validates at 48 x 5 x 1.4 inches and runtime trim stays within the measured baseboard and crown envelopes.
observations.scale_fidelity: Candidate bounds match the ArtBrief sample; RoomDefinition continues to own wall length, trim height, projection, and openings.
observations.semantic_recognizability: The separated baseboard and crown still read as architectural wood trim in the profile captures.
observations.silhouette_quality: Broad faces are now clear, but several stepped contour lines are tighter and more frequent than the approved target's restrained profile.
observations.source_resemblance: The dark stained-wood color and room context approach the source; the uniform surface and extra profile lines remain differences.
observations.surface_variation: The solid matte finish removes the fine stripe defect but also removes the broad subdued grain visible in the approved target.
observations.technical_integration: The Godot 4.7.2 candidate validates at two meshes, two surfaces, and 92 triangles, and renders through the production room with 50 citizens.

close_inspection.evidence: The faces are continuous, but several contour bands remain more prominent than the approved shallow cove and reveal transitions.

edge_treatment.evidence: The extruded profile has continuous exposed edges and a stable five-inch section.

hardware.evidence: The approved trim target has no separate hardware; none is needed on the crown or baseboard.

joins.evidence: Wall-length sections render continuously, but the current captures do not show a clean finished corner join at close range.

manufacturing_detail.evidence: Several closely spaced profile bands remain visible and compete with the broad face hierarchy in the approved target.

material_response.evidence: The dark warm stain is matte and no longer produces the orange stripe pattern seen in v001.

surface_variation.evidence: The smooth v002 faces have no visible grain variation, unlike the target's restrained broad grain.

thickness.evidence: The sample retains its validated 1.4-inch baseboard depth and 0.75-inch crown projection.

neutral_viewer_realism.evidence: The matte wood sections read as residential trim following the room walls.

photo_character.evidence: The broad dark stained-wood faces and deep green wall context approach the photographed room; fine wood variation and the final profile hierarchy still need work.

visual_transfer_diagnosis.corrective_action: For the final attempt, replace the uniform solid stain with a custom low-frequency, low-contrast longitudinal grain material and reduce the contour points to a broad face with a few shallow transitions. Preserve the same profile envelope, wall placement, and RoomDefinition data.
lost_visual_information: The target's subtle broad wood grain is absent from the solid matte faces.
Several added contour bands compete with the target's simple cove/reveal hierarchy.
preserved_components: Continuous dark stained-wood faces without the v001 warm stripe response
Five-inch baseboard and crown heights owned by RoomDefinition
Measured 1.4-inch baseboard depth and 0.75-inch crown projection
Deep green room context and existing wall/opening geometry
